title: 2017 Personality 01: Introduction
summary: The opening lecture of Jordan Peterson's 2017 University of Toronto personality course. He defines personality from historical, constructivist, psychoanalytic, behavioral and neuropsychological angles.
why: Recommended as part of a long lecture series on psychology, complementing biology lectures, and named when HN asks for the best lecture series.

quote.text: the original Personality Lectures (2017) of Jordan Peterson are really great.
